operations.name: read_device_status
operations.desc: Read device status register from VirtIO device
operations.returns: Device status byte indicating device state and features
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
in al, dx
ret

operations.name: read_isr_status
operations.desc: Read Interrupt Status Register to check for pending interrupts
operations.returns: ISR status byte; bit 0 = device events, bit 1 = config change
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc049
in al, dx
ret

operations.name: read_device_features
operations.desc: Read device feature flags from offset 0x04
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc044
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_config_vector
operations.desc: Read MSI-X config vector at offset 0x06
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc046
in ax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_queue_select
operations.desc: Read currently selected queue index from offset 0x0E
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc04e
in ax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_queue_size
operations.desc: Read size of selected queue from offset 0x10
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc050
in ax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_queue_vector
operations.desc: Read MSI-X vector for selected queue from offset 0x12
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc052
in ax, dx
ret
